question: What is the name of the 2025 tournament won by Vidarbha?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ranji Trophy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ranji Trophy** is a prestigious domestic cricket tournament in **India**.
 
• It was established in the year **1934** and is named after **Ranjitsinhji Vibhaji Jadeja**, the famous Indian cricketer who played for England.
 
• The tournament is conducted by the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)**.
 
• The Ranji Trophy follows a **first-class cricket format**, which is played over multiple days.
 
• Teams representing various **Indian states and cricket associations** participate in the tournament.
 
• Vidarbha has been a strong contender in recent years and has won the **Ranji Trophy** in 2018 and 2019.
 
• Winning the Ranji Trophy is considered a stepping stone for players aiming to represent **India in international cricket**.
 
• The 2025 tournament win by Vidarbha highlights their continued excellence in domestic cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vijay Hazare Trophy**__

 __
 
• The **Vijay Hazare Trophy** is a domestic one-day cricket tournament in **India**.
 
• It was named after the legendary Indian cricketer **Vijay Hazare**.
 
• The tournament is played in a **limited-overs format** (50 overs per side).
 
• It provides a platform for players to showcase their skills in **limited-overs cricket**.
 
 
 
• **Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy**__
 __
 
• The **Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy** is a domestic **T20 cricket tournament** in India.
 
• It is named after the famous Indian cricketer **Syed Mushtaq Ali**.
 
• This tournament allows players to demonstrate their abilities in the **shortest format of the game**.
 
 
 
• **Indian Premier League (IPL)**__
 
 
• The **IPL** is a globally popular **franchise-based T20 cricket league** hosted in India.
 
• It involves teams owned by private franchises and features top cricket players from around the world.
 
• The league is known for its high entertainment value and significant financial rewards.
